_comment: Edit questions, points, and the score bands here. Push to main. Scoring: each scored question is worth 0 to 3, in the order the answers are listed. Maximum is 30. Bands: 0-7 Beginner, 8-15 Intermediate, 16-23 Advanced, 24-30 Expert. Adjustments: if Q1 is the first option (value never), the level is capped at Beginner. If Q12 is agents and the score is 12 or more, the level moves up one band, unless the Beginner cap applied. Q11 is free text and is not scored. Q12 sets the path and is not scored. The price does not depend on the level.

bands.label: Beginner
bands.summary: You are at the start, so the session stays practical and unhurried. We get an account working, try a few prompts on a real everyday task, and practise telling a useful answer from a shaky one. You should leave with one or two prompts you can reuse this week.

bands.label: Intermediate
bands.summary: You already use a chat tool, so we spend the time on clearer prompts and a repeatable way to do a real task. Bring work you are allowed to share. You should leave with a template you can run again without me.

bands.label: Advanced
bands.summary: You use AI often, so we build something that can stay in your workflow: a custom assistant, a task that uses a file, or a simple automation. Come with one process you want to improve. You should leave with that workflow started in your own account.

bands.label: Expert
bands.summary: You are ready to connect tools and build an agent or a multi-step automation. We scope one workflow and build as far as the session allows. You should leave with a working piece of that system, plus the next steps to finish it.

work.label: Work productivity
work.summary: We will use a real work task, such as email, meeting notes, or a status update, and turn it into a prompt you can run again.

writing.label: Writing
writing.summary: We will work on drafts, rewrites, or a voice you want the tool to keep, using text you are allowed to share.

research.label: Research
research.summary: We will practise asking a sharper question, checking the answer, and keeping a source trail.

images.label: Images
images.summary: We will make images you can actually use, and write prompts you can change for the next one.

agents.label: Agents and automation
agents.summary: We will map one repeated process and build the first working step of an assistant or an automation.

home.label: AI at home
home.summary: We will pick a home task, such as planning, learning, or organising information, and build a prompt you will use again.

questions.prompt: Be honest, how often does AI show up in your day?

options.label: I've played with it once or twice.
It's open in a tab all day.

questions.prompt: Which AI tools have you met so far?

options.label: A few, including image or meeting tools.
Lots, including automation or agent tools.

questions.prompt: What do you actually use it for?

options.label: Nothing yet, that's why I'm here.
Quick questions, like a smarter Google.
Writing, summarising or making sense of information.
It's part of how I work every day.

questions.prompt: When you ask AI for something, what does it look like?

options.label: I type a question and hope for the best.
I tell it who to be, what I need and how I want it.
I have favourite prompts I reuse and tweak.

questions.prompt: Have you ever handed AI a file, like a PDF, spreadsheet or photo?

options.label: All the time, even for data analysis.

questions.prompt: Have you built your own assistant, like a custom GPT, Claude Project or Copilot agent?

options.label: No, and I'm not sure what that means.
I have a few and share them with others.

questions.prompt: Have you got AI talking to your other tools or doing tasks on its own?

options.label: I've set up one simple automation.

questions.prompt: When AI gives you an answer, how sure are you that it's right?

options.label: I usually take it at face value.
I have a hunch when something's off.
I know exactly where it tends to get things wrong.

questions.prompt: How clear are you on what's safe to share with AI?

options.label: I follow the rules at work.

questions.prompt: When a new app lands on your phone or laptop, you...

options.label: need someone to walk me through it.
get there with a bit of help.

questions.prompt: If AI could take one thing off your plate tomorrow, what would it be?
Where would you love to start?
